failures: identity-less sequential text reused index 0 instead of advancing to index 1
reasoning transition emitted sig_initial instead of final sig_final
response.completed emitted message_stop without closing the reasoning block
duplicate message output_item.done replayed the full text

tests_reviewed.failure: the first tool content event was content_block_delta rather than content_block_start

findings.claim: A completed identity-less text lifecycle remains active and is reused by the next identity-less text item, preventing sequential fallback from advancing.
findings.proof: Two sequential identity-less content_part.added/output_text.delta/content_part.done lifecycles emitted indices [0,0,0,0,0,0] instead of [0,0,0,1,1,1].
findings.required_fix: Treat an identity-less content_part.added event after a closed lifecycle as a new lifecycle, or remove or retire the prior active text lifecycle at content_part.done while preserving correlation for any later output_item.done.

findings.claim: Finalizing reasoning when a tool starts can permanently discard an authoritative signature delivered by the later reasoning completion event.
findings.proof: Reasoning index 2 started with sig_initial, was finalized by tool index 7, and then completed with sig_final. The translator emitted sig_initial and silently discarded sig_final.
findings.required_fix: Retain reasoning finalization state until item completion establishes the final signature, or provide a lifecycle-safe mechanism that can emit the final done signature without reopening or duplicating the content block.

findings.claim: Terminal response events only close stop-pending reasoning blocks and can emit message_stop with a thinking block still open.
findings.proof: A reasoning summary delta followed directly by response.completed produced no content_block_stop for index 2 before message_stop.
findings.required_fix: Before message_delta and message_stop, finalize every open lifecycle that can no longer receive events, including reasoning blocks whose part-done or item-done event is missing.

findings.claim: Tool argument events have no missing-start recovery and can produce a delta and stop stream without a tool_use start.
findings.proof: A function_call_arguments.delta followed by output_item.done emitted content_block_delta as the first tool event and never emitted a content_block_start.
findings.required_fix: Define and test missing-start behavior for tools. Buffer until item metadata is available or otherwise ensure a valid tool_use start precedes all tool deltas and stops.

findings.claim: Completed lifecycle identity is forgotten, so duplicate or delayed message completion events recreate the lifecycle and replay full text.
findings.proof: Repeating the same message output_item.done event emitted the complete answer text twice.
findings.required_fix: Retain bounded completed-item identity or another idempotency guard so stale completion events are no-ops while allowing legitimate identifier reuse only across separate responses.
